exports.DashboardWidgets: ({ source: dashboard.WidgetSource, startEditing?: boolean }) => JSX. Renders the At a glance panel with summary cards and, when opened, the WidgetPicker. startEditing only sets the first render; Home does not pass it, so the picker starts closed.

src/components/Home.tsx.storage: usePref<unknown>(dashboard.LAYOUT_PREF_KEY) which is 'dashboard.widgets' under the 'jarvis.ui.' prefix. The value is the text from serializeLayout, JSON-encoded by the preference writer. A non-string saved value goes through normalizeLayout, so it is validated and reported rather than trusted.

dashboardSource.settings: settings (Pick of onboarded, mode, localModel is used)
dashboardSource.capabilities: system?.capabilities ?? null, so a failed or missing system check reads as Not loaded

markers.summary cards: section.panel.dash-card with data-dash-widget=<kind>, inline grid-column and grid-row from packLayout

dependencies: src/ui/widgets.ts (widgets module; read only, not edited)
limitations: Not in a live DOM. The lockfile has no DOM library, so clicks, keyboard focus and the toggle are not simulated. Tests server-render and check markup and attributes. The picker's edit rules are covered by the pure functions in tests/autopilot-widgets.test.mjs.

Two arrangement systems now coexist on Home. The cockpit panels keep Arrange and the home.layout preference from the shell. The summary cards use the picker and dashboard.widgets. Some content appears twice: Notes, Capsules and Recent activity have both a cockpit panel and a summary card. Whether to merge these is a product decision for the shell owner and captain.

Layout is a 12-column inline grid with no media query. Below the shell's 1000px breakpoint the spans are not collapsed. A styles owner should add a single-column rule for .dash-grid and .dash-card. No CSS was added because styles are outside this module's paths.
Summary text is computed on render from the store passed in. It does not poll. The date-based detail uses the local date at render time.
The saved layout lives in this window's localStorage, like the other UI preferences. Another window updates it only through the usePref storage event.
No screen reader or browser accessibility audit was run. Accessibility is checked through the markup: names, labels, aria-expanded, aria-controls and the status region.
The capability count shows Not loaded until a system check completes. This is deliberate and matches the source contract.
